activity_summary: By dinner the word had come up from the river. Apprentices at Billingsgate had made the fishwives sell at their own price, and by afternoon the cry was not fish. It was strangers, Dutch and French, from street to street. Alse had not gone down to look. You were not cast today or tomorrow, and you kept the house. No one at the table went out to see.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Heard it, and said he was keeping the house.

entities.name: Mistress Dorcas Ansell
entities.context: Stopped any plan to go and look, and bound the door.

entities.name: Alse Pinder
entities.context: Brought the word from the lane and had not gone down.

entities.name: Gillis Verbeke
entities.context: Heard his own people named, and said he would come by the back if he was sent off.

entities.name: Billingsgate
entities.context: Mentioned in It is not fish any longer
